posts.zh:
dsh-client-ui-quote 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在网页聊天输入框上方为选中的 AI 回复内容添加可移除的引用横幅，随下一条消息一并发送。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e918e50f8a53e45d48fe.html
posts.en:
dsh-client-ui-quote is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Adds a removable quote banner above the web chat composer for text selected from an AI reply, included in the next message.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e918e50f8a53e45d48fe.html
